text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Tiara route, the 
Oaks, demands stamina in addition to 
speed. It's a race that decides the 
"strongest," not just the "fastest."

With expectations already running high, 
and Red Desire's recent performance on top 
of that—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Until we meet again at the Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks). May the Holy Maiden's 
blessing be upon you all...

With the buzz growing even further, the 
excitement surrounding the race on the day 
of had reached a fever pitch.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Japanese Oaks might turn out 
to be just as thrilling as the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby)!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A clash between rivals, Buena Vista and 
Red Desire! Man, this is gonna get the 
blood pumping!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Fresh in everyone's memory is definitely 
Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka's rivalry! Man, 
that was so intensely hype!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally expecting another intense 
clash like that! Our showdown in the Oaks 
didn't happen back then... so I'm really 
looking forward to this!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, did you see "The 1st"? The fan poll 
where they pick their favorite for each 
race. Buena-chan was number one for the 
Oaks too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
See, she's super popular! Truth be told, I 
voted for Buena-chan too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her run in the Oka Sho was amazing, too! 
Today will definitely be—ah!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: It's Buena Vista! Buena Vistaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Looking forward to a great race!" "Bring 
home the win~!" "Buena-chan, give it your 
aaallll!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list:
(Even before the race, the excitement is 
overwhelming...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, whew...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much! I'll give it 
my all again today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That was amazing...!
choice_data_list:
Are you okay? You looked like you were 
shaking...

Are you okay? You looked like you were 
trembling...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. That was just... her 
switch flipping on!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Carrying all of everyone's expectations... 
a surge of determination came bubbling up 
inside me to do my best!
choice_data_list: So you're trembling with excitement, huh.
So you're trembling with excitement, huh.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, though it almost feels a bit too 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to turn everyone's feelings into 
real strength... and win."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "So... may I have one from you, too?"
choice_data_list: Of course. Do your best, Buena!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! However... I'd like to hear a 
little more.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Will you let me hear those special words, 
meant only for you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. I'm off!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena-chaaaan! Buena Vistaaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...M-Man, this is tough! The cheers for 
Buena-chan are way too loud...!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What's with this overwhelming heroine 
aura...? Ugh, we've been working hard too, 
you know...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for your support! 
Today, with all my might—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Hey... what's wrong with Desire? Is she, 
like, meditating or something...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Desire-chan...?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Tokyo, 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the Oka Sho, the biggest 
concern is whether she can adapt to the 
sudden, drastic increase in distance...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So many Umamusume have fallen to their 
knees before this wall, forced to give up 
on their beautiful dream of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Could this also be an ordeal granted by 
the World? No—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, this must be the favor of 
the divine. After all, these conditions 
are advantageous for me."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks is a bestowed opportunity. The 
longer the distance, the more my true 
essence shines—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Just like that person I look up to.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh! Just now, I thought... I saw 
someone—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was chosen to be here. This race 
will unfold quite differently from the Oka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Today will surely serve as the 
touchstone... for going to "that place."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san. I will reach 'that place.' 
Won't you please bear witness?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...I'm sorry. I... can't do that."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I struggled with it so much. There is a 
world you want to reach... Standing in 
your way is truly agonizing for me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still... when it comes to the one I 
admire, I have feelings I won't back down 
on either!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo 2400m is the same course as the 
Japan Cup that Spe-san won...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The origin of the breathtaking dream we 
strive for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If I want to make my dream come true... —I 
can't afford to lose on this course!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, those eyes shining with fierce 
resolve! That is truly the mark of this 
world's protagonist...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You are Schwarz, and I am Weiss. Black and 
white clashing against each other—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I shall illuminate everything 
with the light of the Saint...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you do that. I told you I was 
prepared, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's a fair-and-square showdown! —Let's do 
this!
